This is really neat.

While this document isn't absolutely necessary, and doesn't really add much to the 884 article, it was really fun to get to see one of my favorite skips from a different point of view. And I love the CI format.

+1

Two questions, though:

1. What's going on in the first step? Was the defector someone who had previously worked at the Foundation with 884? If so, why did they need to track him to Site-37 - wouldn't he have told them the location already? And why would he return there in the first place - didn't he defect? Wouldn't the Foundation terminate him for that?

2. In the Foreword (and the page history), you mention that the O5 knew about the mirror's effect all along. So then why didn't they restrict Foundation personnel from interacting with it? Why did they allow the CI plot to succeed, and so many Foundation people to die?
